description:
Advances: specled.coverage_capture

Root cause found during specled_-epl ship preflight, diagnosed via the new seed-echo feature (failing merged run echoed seed 354632; standalone repro: mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs --seed 354632).

SpecLedEx.Coverage.Store.status_path/1 (lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex:265) resolves the last_run.status sidecar to dirname(artifact_path). The v2 describe-block setup (test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs:124-133) builds tmp_path directly in System.tmp_dir!(), so the sidecar is $TMPDIR/last_run.status — a machine-global file shared by every concurrently running BEAM and left behind by killed runs. Symptoms: 'returns {:refused, :not_found} when no sidecar has ever been written' (line 266) reads another run's leftover status; the refused-write test can read a concurrent run's status. Observed: failed in a merged tagged_tests run while two full spec.checks ran concurrently; failed once standalone from leftover pollution (its own on_exit then cleaned the file, so re-runs passed).

Production is unaffected (artifact lives in repo-local .spec/_coverage/). Fix: give the setup a unique per-test subdirectory so the sidecar is test-private. Likely also the real identity of some past 'flaky one-off failures in full-suite runs' (specled_-f98 lineage); unrelated to the tracer property flake (specled_-epl) and to the tempfile race (specled_-vnw).

comments.text: Second instance fixed post-close: the read_status/1 describe block had its own tmp-root setup (missed by the first fix, caught by the mix test --include integration preflight failing at store_test.exs:268 with a concurrent {:ok, per_test} status). Commit on specled_-epl/flake-capture. Suite now has zero $TMPDIR-root last_run.status readers/writers; triple-green under deliberate pollution.

title: [BUG] store_test v2 setup shares $TMPDIR/last_run.status across BEAMs — flaky read_status tests
